Q5004.reason: The executory interest violates the Rule Against Perpetuities because a later-born child could turn 25 more than 21 years after every life in being has died, leaving the friend with absolute title.

Q8166.reason: Maine’s use of “hitherto” presents a historical observation, but the aphorism is often misread as a prediction of inevitable future development.

Q5649.reason: A postoperative patient may require free drainage or accurate urine-output monitoring, whereas patient preference, bladder sensation, and no measurement requirement favor a catheter valve.
